name: Blue Water Seafood Ocean Beach
menu_notes: Compared against bluewaterseafoodsandiego.com's live 'Ocean Beach' food menu page (sdbluewater.com 301-redirects there) plus WebSearch corroboration (Yelp/Tripadvisor). All 10 checked items matched at exact price: Seared Ahi Plate $34, Scallops Plate $36, Swordfish/Mahi/Halibut Plates $32, Salmon Plate $28.95, Track Taco $9.50, Beer Battered Cod Taco $7.50, Mini Beer Shrimp Tacos (3) $12.50, Fried Calamari $15, and Happy Hour Fish Taco $6. Of the 353 dishes, programmatic analysis found ~24 rows (12 name pairs, e.g. Margarita/Mai Tai/Mezcal Penicillin/Ceviche/Poke Nachos) that are legitimate regular-price vs Happy-Hour-price duplicates of the same drink/dish, not data errors, confirmed by the real site's separate Happy Hour pricing. ~15 rows in the 'Sauces' section (9 loose condiments at $0.25, 6 '8oz' bottled sauces) are modifier/add-on style items rather than standalone dishes, but they are real a-la-carte menu rows on the Toast ordering system, not junk. No non-food/admin rows (fees, gift cards, theme flags) and no absurd prices were found ($0.25-$38 range, all plausible). The real driver of the high count is a legitimate 'choose your fish' menu matrix: ~28 fish/protein names (Ahi, Yellowtail, Halibut, Swordfish, Wahoo, Seabass variants, etc.) are each offered across up to 5 preparation formats (Plate/Salad/Sandwich/Taco/Sashimi), accounting for ~100 rows, plus an unusually large full bar menu (Mixed Drinks 64, Draft Beer 29, N/A Drinks 23, Wine 19, Bottle Beer 12) accounting for ~150 rows. This matches the real restaurant, which is a seafood market/grill + bar with daily-changing fish selection and a large drink list.
data_notes: Address 5083 Santa Monica Ave, San Diego, CA 92107 and neighborhood 'Ocean Beach' are correct (confirmed via Yelp/Tripadvisor listings for 'Blue Water Seafood Market & Grill - Ocean Beach'); our suite is 'Ste 2B' vs Yelp/Tripadvisor's 'Ste 1B'/'5083 Santa Monica Ave' with no suite - a trivial discrepancy, likely just a different rendering of the same small strip-mall unit. Cuisine 'Seafood' is correct. lat/lng (32.7483664, -117.2520418) place it correctly in Ocean Beach, San Diego County. Restaurant is open and active (current 2026 reviews/photos on Yelp and Tripadvisor, no closure signals). hours field is null in our record - a real gap, though not contradicted by anything found (real site shows Happy Hour Mon-Fri 3-5pm but not full operating hours).
